newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Super Coffeemix in $26 mln share placement.
newsitem.headline: Super Coffeemix in $26 mln share placement.

text.p: Super Coffeemix Manufacturing Ltd said on Wednesday it would sell 20 million new ordinary shares at Singapore $1.34 per share to raise about S$26 million.
The new shares would raise the company's issued and paid up capital share to S$11.18 million, from S$10.18 million.
The new shares represent about 9.82 percent of the company's issued share capital.

The proceeds raised from the sales will be used, among other things, to subscribe for 8.1 million new ordinary shares of S$1.00 each in Super Continental Pte Ltd following a joint venture deal signed on February 17.

Super Continental is a Singapore-based joint venture company between India's Continental Coffee Ltd and Singcafe, a limited partnership registered in the U.S. state of Delaware, to make soluble coffee for sale in Singapore and abroad.
Share trading in Super Coffeemix was suspended shortly after lunch on Wednesday prior to the share placement announcement.
